name: EULA ~2026 Human Creativity Report~
summary: 在人工与 AI 两种模式之间切换的视觉小说。开发者披露 AI 模式的角色图像、剧本和音频为预先生成，游玩时不实时生成。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 开发者明确表示游玩时没有实时 AI 生成。
aiAreaNotes.code: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。
aiAreaNotes.art: AI 模式角色图像使用生成式 AI，不代表人工模式也使用。
aiAreaNotes.music: 披露说明 AI 模式音频使用 AI，但没有将其进一步分为音乐或配音。
aiAreaNotes.voice: 披露说明 AI 模式音频使用 AI，但没有将其进一步分为音乐或配音。
aiAreaNotes.writing: AI 模式情节与剧本使用生成式 AI。
aiAreaNotes.translation: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。
aiAreaNotes.marketing: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Exactly half of this game's content is AI-generated. This is intentional, and part of the gameplay - designed to convey the difference between AI-created and human-made works. [AI Usage] - AI Mode character graphics: AI-generated - AI Mode scenario / script: AI-generated - AI Mode audio: AI-generated - The giraffe - Any other elements necessary for in-game [Non-AI Usage] - Organic Mode character art: Human-made - Organic Mode story: Human-made - Organic Mode music / sound effects: Human-made - Any other elements necessary for in-game cinematics ※ All content was pre-produced during development. No real-time AI generation is used during gameplay.

sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 4 个主题（总数 4）；仅覆盖首页。

sources.label: The EULA
sources.excerpt: Player feedback on the readability of the EULA; not evidence of AI use in a specific production area.

sources.label: Awesome demo, just one minor complaint:
sources.excerpt: Demo feedback about controls and pronouns; visible developer replies report fixes. No additional AI-use claim is established.

sources.label: imo the way the game present the topic seems a bit dishonest.
sources.excerpt: Players dispute how the game compares human and AI work. These are community opinions, not a developer disclosure or independent audit.

sources.label: Demo feedback
sources.excerpt: Demo feedback discusses the human/AI comparison and a frame-rate issue; visible developer replies report a fix.

sources.label: 4Gamer: human and AI story modes
sources.excerpt: 4Gamer reports that the visual novel switches between human-created and AI-created illustrations and writing. Its April announcement used an earlier release date; current release information comes from Steam.

english.summary: A visual novel that contrasts human-made and AI modes. The developer discloses pre-generated character graphics, scripts and audio in AI mode, with no live generation during play.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full Steam disclosure, identity and the discussion homepage in the English interface (4 visible topics). Also read 4 topics and all visible replies. Public coverage was searched separately for this game. Discussion coverage is limited to the homepage and search is not exhaustive. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
